name: woori_server
implemented: NestJS src/common + src/domain + src/admin + independent worker structure
local PostgreSQL 16 migrations and restricted woori_api runtime role
scrypt password authentication, hashed revocable web sessions and Origin protection
one-time account-bound email verification; private development mail files and Resend adapter
membership-scoped groups and album reads; atomic owner membership on group creation
hashed invitation code/link, owner controls and serializable bounded/idempotent joining
database-backed request limiting and explicit verified proxy-hop configuration
pure notification eligibility policy; isolated PostgreSQL integration tests
notImplemented: actual external email delivery verification, mail outbox/retries and account recovery
native refresh tokens, admin authentication/MFA and operations
album/photo writes, R2 upload/media adapters and image processing
worker queue handlers, production backup and restore validation

deployment.worker: Railway paid; separate service; Serverless off

database.authorization: RLS allows server runtime role across granted rows; per-user group isolation is enforced in API membership queries

runtimeConfiguration.WEB_ORIGIN: local http://localhost:3210; production exact HTTPS web origin
runtimeConfiguration.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: comma-separated exact origins; required for browser mutations
runtimeConfiguration.TRUST_PROXY_HOPS: 0 locally; 1 only for a verified single trusted proxy topology
runtimeConfiguration.MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: separate migration connection; explicit migrate/prepare only
runtimeConfiguration.MAIL_MODE: file locally (no external email); resend after provider setup
runtimeConfiguration.DEV_MAIL_DIR: absolute private directory outside repositories, development only
runtimeConfiguration.RESEND_API_KEY: server secret for Resend mode; never NEXT_PUBLIC
runtimeConfiguration.envLoading: dev/start/migrate scripts load gitignored .env; DB compose loads .env.local-db
